Near the rocks, I found a smooth stone shaped like a heart. Dad said we could look for different shapes without taking stones away from the beach. (2) ____ We placed them together, took a photograph and then left them where we had found them.

filled_article:
### September 3

Our family went to a beach today. I had packed a football because I wanted to play on the sand. When we arrived, however, the wind was strong. Sand kept blowing into our faces. So we put the ball back in the car and went for a walk.

Near the rocks, I found a smooth stone shaped like a heart. Dad said we could look for different shapes without taking stones away from the beach. I soon found a round one and a very flat one. We placed them together, took a photograph and then left them where we had found them.

It began to rain just before noon. We found a small shelter beside a closed café. From our seats inside, we could still see the waves through a large window. We ate our sandwiches there.

When the rain stopped, we returned to the car. I was sorry not to have played football, but I had enjoyed looking closely at the beach. The photograph on my phone was my favourite memory. I will show it to my friend tomorrow and tell her about the heart-shaped stone.
